6289.title: Responsive pane swaps discard live thread state
6289.rootCauseOneLine: The compact-mode branch replaces the single-thread component tree, recreating the editor and timeline scroll owner.
6289.proposedFix: Keep the single-thread owner mounted across compact transitions after deciding stable pane identity and page/pane semantics.
6289.caveats: Container lifecycle verified twice with the existing textarea fixture; full ProseMirror cursor position, performance and device behavior not tested. No fix PR because pane identity/surface compatibility needs a product decision.
